edition: EN 10365:2017 / EN 10056-1:2017 / EN 10210-2:2006 / EN 10219-2:2006 dimensions; section properties from the EN 10365 / EN 10056-1 tables, ArcelorMittal Orange Book and UPE table, eurocodepy (EN 10210-2) and the SCI Blue Book P363 (EN 10219-2)
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Values not printed by the source are computed exactly from the published dimensions and listed per shape in 'computed'.

sources.AM: EN 10365:2017 IPE/HEA/HEB/HEM section tables (A, I, W, Wpl identical to the ArcelorMittal sales programme) as transcribed in domthom21/eurocodedesign @1b57c8d (MPL-2.0), eurocodedesign/geometry/steelsections/_data/{ipe,hea,heb,hem}_en10365_2017.csv
sources.SC-UPE: ArcelorMittal UPE table (EN 10365:2017 dimensions) as transcribed in fib-international/structuralcodes @3e9c3f5 (Apache-2.0), tests/test_geometry/test_profiles/upe.json
sources.OB: ArcelorMittal Europe 'Orange Book' (EN 1993 section properties, orangebook.arcelormittal.com) as transcribed in waynemaranga/steelsnakes @78744cd (GPL-2.0), src/steelsnakes/EU/data/*.json
sources.ECD-L: EN 10056-1:2017 angle tables as transcribed in domthom21/eurocodedesign @1b57c8d (MPL-2.0), L_en10056_2017.csv
sources.HF: EN 10210-2 hot-finished hollow sections as transcribed in eurocodepy 2027.0.8 (PyPI; GPL-3.0), eurocodepy/data/{chs,rhs,shs}_profiles_euro.json
sources.CF: EN 10219-2 cold-formed hollow sections, SCI/BCSA 'Blue Book' (P363, Eurocode edition) tables as transcribed in jsbayley/gazelle @eff4332 (AGPL-3.0), src/.d/bluebook/properties/cf-*.json

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; I-shapes/channels/tees: d along local 2. Channels: back of web at 3=0, flanges toward +3. Angles: heel at origin, leg d along +2, leg b along +3; I33/I22 about leg-parallel centroidal axes, alpha = angle (rad) from local 3 to the major principal axis, positive toward +2. x0/y0 = shear centre minus centroid along 3/2. As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf (I/channel); 5/6*d*t, 5/6*b*t (angle); 2*d*t, 2*b*t (RHS); A/2 (CHS).
